chunks: And his wealth will not avail him when he falls headlong.
ai.seo_question: What happens to a person's wealth when they fall into Hell?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Layl, this verse underscores the transient nature of material wealth against the eternal reality of divine reckoning, a theme central to Shia ethical teachings on detachment (zuhd). It serves as a poignant reminder that despite the accumulation of riches, one cannot bribe or appease God’s judgment, emphasizing the necessity of sincere faith and righteous deeds for salvation.
